parameters.content:
Env (required)
- N8N_REALM (default: default)
- GITLAB_API_BASE_URL (or GITLAB_BASE_URL)
- N8N_GITLAB_TOKEN (or GITLAB_TOKEN)
- HR_TALENT_GITLAB_PROJECT_ID or HR_TALENT_GITLAB_PROJECT_PATH

Env (optional)
- HR_TALENT_DEFAULT_BRANCH (default: main)
- HR_TALENT_APPROVE_LABELS (default: status:approved)

Behavior
- Scans issues with labels: hr-skill-update + status:pending-approval
- Approval: Issue label (status:approved) OR note starting with /approve
- Writes: creates file ledger/skill_updates/skill_update_<iid>.yml in MR
